pilot_metrics.name: Time to Revocation Notice (SLA)
pilot_metrics.signal: Elapsed hours from revocation decision timestamp to formal notification timestamp.
pilot_metrics.threshold_rule: Instance target must be defined before activation; any breach of the adopted revocation-notification SLA enters triage.

evidence.name: Revocation notification timing evidence
evidence.description: Timestamped record linking a revocation decision to the corresponding formal notification event.

provenance.note: Evidence contract/template; no runtime evidence is asserted by this record.

pilot_metrics.name: IDVC Issuer Verification Rate
pilot_metrics.signal: Percentage of Phase 4 admissions with IDVP DID and authority verified before VMC issuance.
pilot_metrics.threshold_rule: Target is 100%; any unverified admission is a triage event.

evidence.name: IDVP issuer verification evidence
evidence.description: Admission-time evidence that the IDVP DID and authorisation state were verified before VMC issuance.

provenance.note: Evidence contract/template; no runtime evidence is asserted by this record.

pilot_metrics.name: Registry Write Authorisation Failure Rate
pilot_metrics.signal: Percentage of unauthorised single-party registry write attempts rejected by policy enforcement.
pilot_metrics.threshold_rule: Target is 100% rejection; any successful unauthorised write is a critical triage event.

evidence.name: Registry write authorisation rejection evidence
evidence.description: Audit evidence for attempted registry writes and the authorisation decision applied to each attempt.

provenance.note: Evidence contract/template; no runtime evidence is asserted by this record.

pilot_metrics.name: Agent Credential Scope Violation Rate
pilot_metrics.signal: Rate of agent actions attempted or executed outside the delegated credential scope.
pilot_metrics.threshold_rule: Target is zero successful out-of-scope actions; attempted violations are retained for trend review.

evidence.name: Agent scope violation evidence
evidence.description: Structured event evidence for attempted or successful actions outside an agent's delegated credential scope.

provenance.note: Evidence contract/template; no runtime evidence is asserted by this record.

pilot_metrics.name: Agent Liveness Check Interval Compliance Rate
pilot_metrics.signal: Percentage of required operator/agent liveness checks completed within the adopted interval.
pilot_metrics.threshold_rule: Target is 100% interval compliance; missed liveness checks suspend reliance until re-established.

evidence.name: Agent liveness compliance evidence
evidence.description: Timestamped liveness-check records sufficient to establish whether the required operator/agent liveness interval was met.

provenance.note: Evidence contract/template; no runtime evidence is asserted by this record.
